$comment: Client policies applied by scripts/realm/apply.mjs. civicos-session-rules (executor in the extension) refuses a token refresh, for every client, when the session no longer meets the sign-in rules: a council SSO session past civicos.ssoSessionMaxSeconds, a non-SSO session at an organisation that now requires SSO, or a password or code session whose mailbox check is past civicos.mailboxMaxAgeSeconds.
